pages.text: $(o)When the sun sinks and the stars wake,$(br)those who once kept watch begin to walk again.$(br2)Hooded, their lanterns dark, the undead wander the night,$(br)still clutching the words they could not protect.$()

$(o)Slay an undead that walks after dark and take the first page.$(br)Read it, and it joins this Almanac,$(br)and the road to the light opens.$()$(br2)$(o)A recovered page, once read, becomes part of this Almanac and reveals the next step of the journey. At the end of every chapter lie the Order's words - and behind every word, a place.$()
